What the studio does

Fine line

Fine line tattoos come up most often in recent reviews, described as quick, precise and beautiful.

Realism and large pieces

Full sleeves, chest and full back pieces, realism and Japanese-inspired work, done over several long sessions.

Cover-ups and more styles

Cover-ups and refreshing old tattoos, lettering, tribal, Maori and Polynesian styles, black and grey or colour, as the studio’s own window sign lists.

Piercing

A tattoo and piercing studio, as the gold letters on the window say. Four Google reviews mention piercings.

How it works

How customers describe it on Google.

Consultation

Time to talk through your idea and plan the placement, with suggestions on how it could look even better.

Your design, refined

Bring your own design or an idea. Customers write that it is adjusted until it is right, even redrawn several times.

Clean and sterile

Reviews in English and German praise strict hygiene and a clean, professional studio.

On Grigori Afxentiou

Tattoo Studio 77 is at Grigori Afxentiou 19 in Larnaca, behind a red front with a tall TATTOO sign. Several artists work here, and many customers come back for their next piece. One writes that his artist has tattooed at least 20 of his colleagues, another has had almost 80 percent of her tattoos done here.
